subject: general
question: Which of the following statements about the accuracy or precision of electronic instruments is correct?

options.text: The precision is the degree to which the repeated measurement gives the same result.
The accuracy and precision are the degree to which the measurement gives the same value.
The accuracy of the measurement is getting the same value for respective measurements.
The precision is the degree to which the repeated measurement gives quoted value.

solution:
The correct answer is __The precision is the degree to which the repeated measurement gives the same result.**(Option 1)**.__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Precision__ is defined as the degree to which repeated measurements under unchanged conditions yield the same results.
 
• __Accuracy__
